correctness.rationale: Exactly 60 labelled Hamiltonian six-cycles and 10 pairs of disjoint triangles comprise all degree-2 spanning graphs, every edge is in 28; character expansion modulo four gives W(s)=70-2(28)|s|=2 mod4, ruling out zero globally. Independently enumerated all 5005 six-edge subsets, retained precisely 70 degree-two masks, ran exact integer Walsh transform across 2^15 characters and matched the full signed histogram. Reciprocal multiplier with LCM=2310 and exact second transform matched seven integer numerator levels with 32256 zeros and 512 nonzeros; all supported at even-size Eulerian masks. Integer numerator absolute sum 362840064 yields norm 362840064/(32768*2310)=3691/770. Group Fourier diagonalization gives inverse ℓ² norm 1/2; convolution sign vectors attain the endpoint ℓ¹/∞ norm. Scope is exactly K6, no extrapolation to n>6.
